title: The constants K and λ in Ramanujan's identity (9.2.5) of the Lost Notebook, with a hexagonal lattice sum calculator
description: Andrews and Berndt (Ramanujan's Lost Notebook, Part IV, pp. 215–216) could not identify the constants K and λ in Ramanujan's identity (9.2.5). We show that it holds for Re s > 2 with K = μ − ν and λ = μ + ν (sum over coprime μ, ν ≥ 1), prove it from the Andrews–Berndt form via the six-fold symmetry of the Eisenstein integers (orbit-partition lemma with full proof), and give an in-browser calculator for the resulting hexagonal sector lattice sum R(s). The 6-page paper also gives a fast evaluation of R(s) and the closed forms R(6k) = (−1)^k (c_k E_6(ρ)^k − 3)/3 for all k ≥ 1 (c_1 = 1, c_2 = 250/691, c_3 = 5500/43867, ...; c_1…c_12 exactly, with OEIS drafts). Version 1.3 adds one-command verification (python3 verify/verify_all.py: 14 pass/fail checks, exit code 0 iff all pass), a mutation test (17 deliberate alterations, each detected) and Figure 1. Numerical agreement is empirical, not a rigorous error bound: relative 8e-16 to 3.5e-12 at seven real s, 5.4e-17 to 5.8e-11 at three complex s.
